detections.sql:
SELECT u.full_name 
FROM users u 
JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id 
JOIN ( 
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT device_fingerprint) AS device_count 
  FROM login_events 
  WHERE user_agent IS NOT NULL 
  GROUP BY user_id 
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_fingerprint) >= 3 
) le2 ON u.user_id = le2.user_id 
JOIN ( 
  SELECT user_id 
  FROM transactions 
  WHERE UPPER(instrument) LIKE '%CRYPTO%' OR UPPER(instrument) LIKE '%FOREX%' 
  AND created_at >= date('now', '-1 hour') 
) t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
WHERE le.user_agent IN ( 
  SELECT user_agent 
  FROM login_events 
  WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-1 hour') 
  GROUP BY user_agent 
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 
)
